fee_notes: Royalty: 7% of Gross Revenue with annual minimum (calculated via MPR starting month 13). Brand Fund: 2% of Gross Revenue (max 2%, may be specified differently with notice). Local Marketing: $42,000/year for first 5 years, then greater of 8% of prior year gross revenue or $42,000. Website Fee: $350/month (up 10% increase allowed with 30 days notice). Technology Fee: $450/month base (up to $500/month maximum, plus allocated costs for new tools). Additional fees: Call Center setup $7,600, pre-opening training (variable), opening support ($500/day + expenses if requested), territory infringement penalties (escalating 25%-100% of unauthorized revenue), non-compliance fees ($500-$1,000 per violation).

Local Marketing: $42,000 per calendar year for first 5 years, then greater of 8% of prior year Gross Revenue or $42,000. Website Fee: $350 monthly. Technology Fees: Currently, $450 per month.
